standard: VN academic journal manuscript, IMRaD (config_1.json, FORMAT_CONFIG_GUIDE.md worked example)

checks.description: The Vietnamese title text is present.

assert.value: Hiệu quả của vận động sớm

checks.description: headings.titleVn's align: center is applied as a direct paragraph-alignment override — this is the exact gap the pre-extension diagnostic found unrendered.
headings.titleVn's bold: true is applied as a direct run override.
headings.titleVn.wordStyle = Normal is applied even though the block is a heading — no Heading1 style exists in this template at all.
headings.titleEn adds italic on top of bold, both as direct run overrides.
headings.sectionLabel (bold, left) renders the Vietnamese section heading in bold.
This config sets no docFeatures, so no cover page renders.

typography.defaultAlignment = justify; body paragraphs get no forced direct alignment (per the 'apply only what's specified' rule) — the template's own Normal style is expected to carry justification.

assert.value: Nghiên cứu đoàn hệ tiến cứu
